retrievalProfile.description: A somber, wide-angle shot of a weathered mobile home in a rural setting under a heavy overcast sky, featuring a mix of industrial advisory labels and personal handwritten signatures.
excludeWhen: vibrant or sunny lighting is required
modern urban architecture is the focus
clean, minimalist corporate design is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A square-format photograph of a single-story, light blue mobile home with a small wooden porch. The structure is surrounded by dormant, leafless trees and overgrown brown grass. A small black cat sits on the porch. The sky is a flat, desaturated grey. The image features a high-contrast black and white advisory label in the bottom left and a white, fluid handwritten signature in the bottom right.
coreVisualRelationships: The horizontal mobile home anchors the center-middle ground against a vertical backdrop of bare trees.
The small black cat provides a focal point of life amidst a stagnant, decaying environment.
The stark white signature in the bottom right balances the heavy black advisory block in the bottom left.
The desaturated blue of the house contrasts with the warm, muddy browns of the foreground grass.
coreInvariants: Overcast, flat lighting with no harsh shadows
Muted, desaturated color palette dominated by grey, blue, and brown
Presence of a weathered, lived-in structure

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The mobile home is centrally located, occupying the middle third of the vertical frame and most of the horizontal width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white door and the black cat on the porch serve as the primary central anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the central house, moves down to the advisory label, sweeps across the foreground grass to the signature, and finally rises to the sky.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The top third of the frame is dedicated to a textured, overcast sky, providing breathing room for the busy foreground.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm brown and tan (dead grass and leaves)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation throughout with mid-range values; highlights are suppressed to maintain a somber mood.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to earth tones and cool greys

letterConstructionRules: Varying line weight mimicking a paint marker or thick ink
Connected, overlapping characters with long, sweeping ascenders and descenders
characterSpecificRedesigns: The final character features a large, circular loop that encompasses the preceding letters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A rigid, sans-serif block (advisory label) paired with a chaotic, organic script (signature).
graphicDevices: Rectangular black box for advisory text

preserve: The contrast between the formal label and the informal signature
The white color of the script
avoid: Clean, geometric sans-serifs for the signature

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the raw, personal energy of the original signature
Matches the fluid stroke weight and tapered ends

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square photograph of a weathered blue mobile home in a field of dead grass under a grey overcast sky with bare trees in the background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a white, hand-drawn gestural signature in the bottom right corner and a standard black and white parental advisory box in the bottom left corner.

verificationChecks: Is the sky flat and overcast?
Is the signature fluid and white?
Is the house a desaturated blue?
Is the overall mood somber and rural?

adjustableVariables: Color of the mobile home siding
mustRedesign: Specific brand logos on the house or vehicles
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the signature does not look like a standard computer font.
Verify the advisory label is legible and correctly positioned.
Check that the cat is visible but not the primary subject.
Confirm the 1:1 aspect ratio is maintained.
recipe.reuseFormula: Rural Desolation [Subject: Mobile Home] + [Lighting: Overcast/Flat] + [Palette: Muted Blue/Brown] + [Graphics: Corner-weighted Label and Script]
